# The UI test classes a data-only change runs.
#
# A pull request whose files are all under Data/, TestFlight/, docs/ or
# tools/, or are Markdown, runs these instead of the whole UI suite (see
# `plan.py`). The engine suite and `checkout-less-tests` still run in full.
#
# **Chosen by what each class reads, not by its name,** on 29 October 2026,
# from the app's readers of each Data/ file and every test's launch arguments
# and assertions. A class is here when its result can turn on something in
# Data/: a named day's word, a word's verdict or rarity band, a definition, an
# etymology or a licence text, or today's board's content where a layout or a
# rank is near its limit.
#
# **Left out on purpose:** the classes that hold on any well-formed board, such
# as gestures, sheets, settings, sound switches and the showcase archive, which
# seeds outcomes and no words. The engine suite already holds every calendar
# day to a buildable board, its source word to its own basket, and the sequence
# to its pins, so "a board exists" needs no UI test. The costume table and the
# epochs are Swift, so a change to either is code and runs everything.
#
# **When in doubt, a class goes in.** Leaving one out wrongly lets a data change
# break it unseen until the next code change; putting one in wrongly costs a
# minute or two. A new UI test class that reads data belongs here as well as in
# `shards.txt`.
#
# class                       what it reads
ARecordBelowItsBoard          21 October's word, reassure, and erasure outside its basket
ArchiveBeaFirstOpen           thirteen past boards rebuilt from the calendar and the lists
ArchivePeachDays              whether past days' source words are in their own baskets
CostumeOnTheDay               Halloween's board replayed from the calendar, and industry's reveal card
CueAtEachMoment               today's source word inside its basket, for which cue a find asks
DailyReminder                 17 July's word, courtesy, typed to play the day
DayRollsOverOnForeground      today's and tomorrow's source words, which must differ
DefinitionCardExits           the first chip's definition, whose length decides drag or scroll
DefinitionReveal              Uncommon, Rare and source chips on today's board, and Rare definitions
FirstFindShove                a word learned from today's board, and the list after it
LicencesList                  the text of both Soundscape licence files
MarkInTheWell                 24 October's board, literary, where tel is Mythic
MeterTopRung                  the seeded basket reaching the top rung's share of par
MythicGlint                   Mythic words on 17 July's and 24 October's boards
OneBeatPerFind                today's source word inside its basket, for the completion beat
RackAtLargeText               the meter and the first group's header and chip at large sizes
RackScrollTests               the meter and well's height above the rack, against a table of phones
RackShape                     the eight tiles of today's source word
RevealButtonReach             the longest and shortest etymology entries
RungSheetDefinitions          27 October's word, fragment, and its Mythic words' definitions
TapTheWell                    24 October's words: tel, aret, lay and lyt
TitleAndTopRowAtEverySize     today's rank name and count, chosen as the tightest top row
